description.value: Pokébar is a fast-casual Hawaiian-style poké bowl restaurant where guests build fully customizable bowls starting from rice, noodles, or greens bases and layered with fresh-daily fish and a wide array of proteins, mix-ins, sauces, and toppings. The chain traces its roots to a family sushi restaurant opened in 1989 and now operates multiple BC locations, with the Davie Street outlet serving Vancouver's busy West End. Touring cyclists will find a quick, filling, and relatively healthy meal option with both counter pickup and major delivery app support.
